paragraphs: Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda from Akiva from Panda from Nachum from Birim, from an elder, Bena'ah, Berakhot 55, end of b. Yuchasin: Beita bar Bizna from Ukva from Perana from Tanchum from Birim, from an elder, Mana'ah; Mana'ah from an elder, Nehorai, Haro'eh. Another reading: Bizna bar Zavda from Akiva from Perana. End quotation; see Birim.
